pairs.subject: app-shell
pairs.evidence: examples/hirelane/app/layout.tsx:66 The root layout is the frame that never unmounts, and it mounts its session-scoped residents (ToastProvider, then HostCapabilities) in one place above {children}, with their order written down; nav.test.ts holds the route vocabulary to one page with no dead links.

techniques.evidence: examples/hirelane/app/layout.tsx:67 The one host region is a sibling of the swapping {children}, not a child of it, and its order is stated (inside the provider, above the pages). Its teardown lives in demo-kit useWebMCPTool, whose effect cleanup aborts and unregisters (hooks.ts:143-146). Readiness was not checked.

examples/hirelane/test/nav.test.ts:42 The route vocabulary is reduced to one name for one place. The old /v index was removed and a test asserts nothing addresses it. Another test (line 65) asserts every href, redirect and revalidatePath lands on a page that exists, which is the 'entry with no route' check. The board's in-state level model is outside this context.
examples/hirelane/app/page.tsx:17 There is a single section on a single route, and it loads all of its data before the first frame on purpose, so there are no sections to split or prefetch.

examples/hirelane/app/actions.ts:7 Here 'gated' means agent acts that need approval because they cannot be undone, not plan or role entitlements. Searching app/, components/ and lib/ for entitle/locked/plan/featureFlag found no tier or flag that controls what the nav shows.
